snippet.title: Ironwing Valiant - Light Air Assault Preview
snippet.description:
We want to show our progress on the Light Air Assault, a Valiant archetype that allows you to transform into a fighter plane or a mecha! Please like and subscribe as we are aiming to add more content with a devlog coming as soon as we can :)

Discord Link: discord.gg/SGYyz2DS

Steam Page ( will update ASAP ): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3871670/Ironwing_Valiant_Record_of_Astera/

Twitter ( weekly Dev updates post here ): https://x.com/Tiger_TeamGames
